name: Staff dispatcher lever (BH-9421: sample ready_unqueued_2h, the ready and orphan-claimed build_queue rows; at level act, release or enqueue them through the queue API, dry run first)

knobs.note: BH-9421: 0 stops every run after the kill-flag check and before any read. Read by bin/staff-dispatcher-lever.sh as ${STAFF_DSP_LEVER_ENABLED:-1}; out of range is one warn line and the default.
BH-9421: minutes a build_queue row stays `ready` (enqueued_at to the worker's as_of) before ready_unqueued_2h counts it and the lever may enqueue it. The ticket's 2h.

BH-9421: minutes a build_queue row stays `claimed` with no running build job before it counts as an orphan and the lever may release it. The ticket's 30 min; bin/jobs-watchdog.sh still releases every claim at 360 min.
BH-9421: new lever action rows per run (claims first, then ready rows). The rest is logged deferred=<n> and offered again next run. 0 = metric only: the sample is posted and no lever runs.

BH-9421: 1 = at level act, post dryRun:true action rows and write nothing to the queue. An operator reads the dry-run rows in the scorecard, then sets 0. 0 = live: the action row is posted, then the queue write runs.
BH-9421: seconds bin/triage-gate.sh --buildable-strict may take before an enqueue. A timeout declines the row.
BH-9421: seconds one run of bin/staff-dispatcher-lever.sh may take. The script re-execs itself under timeout with this value after lane_env_apply.
Test seam: a file bin/staff-dispatcher-lever.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/staff-dispatcher-lever.sh sources STAFF_DSP_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
